mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0% in the most recent month, it signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.0%) signal strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with low inflation
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1050 and CPIAUCSL is below 220, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production exceeds 110 (index 2017=100), it indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is above 110, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past 3 months indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1050 thousand units in the most recent month, it signals strong residential construction activity that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1050, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and industrial production (HOUST > 1050 and INDPRO > 110) signals broad-based economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1050 and INDPRO is above 110, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL below 220), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL is below 220, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
